title: The Pragmatic Programmer
description: A classic guide on practical software craftsmanship covering topics like DRY principles automation and pragmatic thinking.

title: Clean Code
description: Robert C. Martin's handbook on writing readable maintainable code with naming functions and refactoring guidelines.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
description: Martin Kleppmann explains the architecture of reliable scalable systems including replication partitioning and consistency.

title: Sapiens
description: Yuval Noah Harari traces the history of humankind from the cognitive revolution to the modern scientific era.

title: Atomic Habits
description: James Clear presents a framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones through small incremental changes.

title: The Lean Startup
description: Eric Ries introduces validated learning and the build-measure-learn loop for building startups under uncertainty.

title: Thinking Fast and Slow
description: Daniel Kahneman describes the two systems of thought that drive the way we make decisions and judgments.

title: Elasticsearch The Definitive Guide
description: A practical introduction to full-text search analytics and distributed document storage with Elasticsearch.

title: Deep Learning
description: Goodfellow Bengio and Courville provide a comprehensive textbook on neural networks and modern deep learning methods.

title: The Phoenix Project
description: A novel about IT DevOps and how a struggling team turns around a critical project under intense pressure.
